description:
The Vikram Sarabhai Postdoctoral Fellowship known as VISHWAS is a prestigious initiative launched by the Indian government to promote research and innovation in various scientific fields. 

This fellowship was officially launched on October 12, 2020. 

It is named after Dr. Vikram Sarabhai who is widely regarded as the father of the Indian space program. 

The primary objective of the VISHWAS fellowship is to support postdoctoral researchers in their pursuit of advanced research projects in the fields of space science and technology. 

The fellowship aims to foster a culture of research and innovation in India by providing financial support and resources to promising researchers. 

The specific goals of the fellowship include enhancing the quality of research in space science and technology and encouraging collaboration between academic institutions and ISRO. 

The fellowship is intended to support a total of 100 postdoctoral researchers over a span of five years. 

Each fellow is expected to contribute to the advancement of knowledge in their respective fields through innovative research projects. 

The fellowship offers a monthly stipend of INR 55,000 for the duration of the fellowship. 

In addition to the stipend, fellows are also entitled to a research grant of up to INR 2,00,000 per year. 

This grant can be utilized for research-related expenses such as equipment, materials, and travel for research purposes. 

Eligibility for the VISHWAS fellowship is primarily targeted at individuals who have completed their Ph.D. in relevant fields. 

Candidates must have obtained their Ph.D. degree within the last five years. 

There is no specific age limit for applicants but preference is given to younger researchers. 

Candidates must also possess a strong academic background with a minimum of 60% marks in their postgraduate degree. 

The application process for the fellowship is conducted online through the official ISRO website. 

Interested candidates must fill out the application form available on the website. 

They are required to submit a detailed research proposal along with their application. 

The research proposal should outline the objectives, methodology, and expected outcomes of the proposed research project. 

Candidates must also provide their curriculum vitae and copies of their academic certificates. 

The application process is open annually with specific deadlines announced on the ISRO website. 

Shortlisted candidates are typically called for an interview conducted by a panel of experts in the field. 

The final selection of fellows is based on the quality of the research proposal and the performance in the interview. 

Once selected, the fellowship is awarded for a period of two years. 

Fellows may have the option to extend their fellowship for an additional year based on their research progress. 

The fellowship is implemented by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO). 

ISRO is the primary agency responsible for the planning and execution of the fellowship program. 

Contact details for inquiries related to the fellowship can be found on the official ISRO website. 

The fellowship is part of a broader initiative to enhance India's capabilities in space research and technology. 

It aims to build a strong network of researchers who can contribute to national and global scientific advancements. 

The VISHWAS fellowship also encourages interdisciplinary research, allowing fellows to collaborate with other institutions and researchers. 

This initiative is expected to significantly contribute to India's scientific community and technological advancements. 

As of October 2023, the fellowship has successfully onboarded several researchers who are working on diverse projects. 

These projects range from satellite technology to earth observation and space exploration. 

The VISHWAS fellowship is a vital step towards achieving India's vision of becoming a global leader in space research. 

ISRO has set measurable targets for the fellowship to ensure that it meets its objectives effectively. 

Regular assessments and evaluations are conducted to monitor the progress of the fellows and their research projects. 

The fellowship also emphasizes the importance of publishing research findings in reputed journals. 

Fellows are encouraged to present their research at national and international conferences. 

This exposure helps in building their professional networks and enhancing their research capabilities. 

The VISHWAS fellowship is a testament to the Indian government's commitment to promoting research and innovation. 

It provides a platform for young researchers to explore their potential and contribute to significant scientific advancements. 

The fellowship is expected to have a long-lasting impact on the scientific landscape of India. 

By supporting postdoctoral researchers, the VISHWAS fellowship aims to create a robust ecosystem for research and development. 

This initiative aligns with the government's broader goals of enhancing scientific research and technological innovation in the country. 

The fellowship is an important component of India's strategy to harness the potential of its young scientists. 

It is designed to empower researchers and provide them with the necessary resources to excel in their fields. 

The VISHWAS fellowship is a unique opportunity for postdoctoral researchers to engage in cutting-edge research. 

It reflects the Indian government's recognition of the importance of research in driving economic and social development. 

The fellowship is expected to attract talented researchers from various disciplines and backgrounds. 

By investing in research and innovation, the VISHWAS fellowship aims to contribute to the overall growth of the nation. 

The initiative is a significant step towards building a knowledge-driven economy in India. 

Overall, the VISHWAS fellowship is a comprehensive program that addresses the needs of postdoctoral researchers in India. 

It provides them with the necessary support to pursue their research interests and make meaningful contributions to society. 

The fellowship is a clear indication of the Indian government's commitment to fostering a culture of research and innovation. 

Through this initiative, India aims to position itself as a global leader in scientific research and technological advancements.
